name: Dipole Field Evaluation
aliases: Saturn Centred Axial Dipole Field Evaluation
definition: Evaluates the magnetic field of a centred axial dipole at position (x, y, z). The magnetic dipole field is given by B = (μ₀ m / 4π r⁵) · [3xz, 3yz, 2z² - x² - y²]. A regularisation term is applied to r⁵ to prevent singularity at r → 0.
